recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. The current core source now consistently represents ProvenanceActivityType as an example value set for Provenance.activity, and no further core follow-up is recommended for FHIR-32517.
issue_request: FHIR-32517 was Published with resolution Persuasive with Modification. It asked that ProvenanceActivityType not remain an extensible value set, with resolution to change Provenance.activity to an Example binding, use representative ISO 21089 lifecycle sample codes, and update the value set narrative/context to make clear it is a sample.
initial_application: Historical commit cd1c06923912f70a88c90d186ff3283b40e0403b applied the main source changes by changing Provenance.activity from extensible to example and reducing valueset-provenance-activity-type.xml to representative ISO lifecycle codes. The current source still retained stale extensible metadata in source/terminologies/bindings.xml and the valueset-extensible extension on source/terminologies/valueset-provenance-activity-type.xml.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists provenance=Provenance, so the Provenance StructureDefinition is in build scope. The current value set description already says it is an example FHIR value set of representative ISO 21089 lifecycle activity type codes. Later Applied issues FHIR-55798 and FHIR-55797 improved the description and added destroy to the sample code list without reversing the example-binding decision. Confluence and Zulip searches found no contrary community decision.
reconciliation: Changed the active ProvenanceActivityType terminology binding row from extensible to example and removed valueset-extensible=true from the ProvenanceActivityType ValueSet source. No element binding, code-list, or narrative changes were needed.

source/terminologies/valueset-provenance-activity-type.xml: removed the valueset-extensible=true extension so the ValueSet metadata no longer says it is intended for extensible binding.
